+# Recorded AI replay fixtures (format 1)
+
+These files replay **recorded model output**, not successful machining recipes.
+The tests use the real AI panel, worker, argument parser, MCP inbox, document,
+and undo history. Only `ChatTransport::complete` is replaced. No network or
+model installation is needed.
+
+## Source and correspondence
+
+Source: [mkinney/Camcraft, q08 QA recording](https://github.com/mkinney/Camcraft/tree/d9be74b1408654799446f0e05e2c675fefc619c2/qa/q08/q08-20261122T131017Z).
+The source commit is `d9be74b1408654799446f0e05e2c675fefc619c2`.
+The transcript blob is `09832301703903e2bc3ced24bd7bc785f4dce4ff`.
+Its SHA-256 is `1746eb81dfd556db0c29183a4effc58d16b35db29efd1e8bda6485abd2b9a275`.
+
+The model was `qwen3-coder:latest` on local Ollama. The recorded application
+was CamCraft v0.25.0 (`7e2a8119`), Linux x86_64, Native tools mode, with the
+`Offline local (Ollama)` preset. The original `meta` object is retained.
+The recorder captured the requests and replies, not an application export.
+See [the recorder's explanation](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/3411#issuecomment-7079851491).
+
+| Fixture | Original zero-based turn | Initial state | Recorded outcome |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| `q08-finishing.json` | 1 (session 1, step 2) | Original `q08-start.camproj` | Adds `Pocket finishing`; three argument/source refusals; later edits leave 0.1 mm stock and `waterline`. |
+| `q08-edit.json` | 3 (session 1, step 4) | Start project plus the finishing operation from `job-03-after-step3.json` | Changes only the finishing operation. The model deletes and re-adds it, then leaves climb=true, stepdown=0.1, stock=0.05. |
+| `q08-delete.json` | 7 (session 2, step 6) | Original `q08-after-step5.camproj` | Two native delete calls. Current policy must wait for each Allow/Deny decision. |
+
+Each slice contains the **whole recorded turn**, including all 12 rounds
+when the original panel reached its round cap. No final reply is invented.
+The finishing and edit requests did **not** achieve their requested zero
+stock and 0.2 mm stepdown. The tests pin the actual document, not the model's
+claim of success. The roughing operation must retain all recorded parameters.
+This is not a new recording of a successful edit-only model workflow.
+
+For the edit slice, `setup` reconstructs the intermediate operation from the
+recorded job snapshot. Its `params.pocket` is flattened for `add_operation`,
+as that tool requires. This is explicit test setup, not a recorded reply.
+The start project supplies the original model, selection, stock and tool.
+The smaller catalog tool is added before the reconstructed operation.
+
+The source's historical delete calls ran without confirmation (#3424).
+The replay does **not** preserve that bug. Both denial and approval are
+tested against the current policy. A denial preserves the document and
+history, even though the recorded final text claims that all operations
+were deleted. Historical missing system prompts (#3425) are not recreated.
+
+## Format
+
+One JSON object describes one conversation slice:
+
+- `format_version`: currently `1`; unknown versions fail.
+- `source`: repository, immutable commit, transcript path, and zero-based
+  `turn_indices`. `setup_snapshot` names an intermediate job snapshot.
+- `meta`: the original recording metadata, unchanged.
+- `initial_project`: one of the checked-in recorded `.camproj` files.
+- `setup`: explicit MCP calls that reconstruct the slice's initial state.
+- `turns`: original `user`, `session`, `brief_step`, and ordered `rounds`.
+  Each round retains `model_reply` and `usage` from the recording.
+- `refused_call_ids`: argument/source refusals that must produce failed
+  cards, rendered explanations, and real error replies to the model.
+- `expected_operations`: the original job snapshot projected to operation
+  name, kind, tool, source and parameters, in document order.
+
+`ReplayTransport` wraps the captured message fields in the OpenAI-compatible
+`choices[0].message` envelope expected by the shipping parser. It retains
+`finish_reason`, call IDs, index, function names, raw argument **strings**,
+and content. It never extracts tool calls from plain text or normalizes
+argument JSON. Exhaustion and unconsumed replies fail the test.
+
+The original historical `tool_results_sent_this_round` are not replayed.
+The real current dispatcher produces those results. The original snapshots
+supply expected document values; they are not returned by a fake MCP server.
+New additive schema fields are permitted, but every recorded parameter and
+source field must match. Operation counts and order must match exactly.
+Transient toolpaths, collision results and status caches are not goldens.
+Undo and redo are checked against the real before/after document states.
+These software tests do not establish physical-machine safety.
+
+Both `.camproj` files are unchanged copies from the source directory.
+Their original source paths identify public QA assets; replay uses the
+embedded facets and does not read those external paths.
+
+To record another fixture, follow [the recording guide](../../../../../../../docs/agents/ai-chat-replay.md).

+# Record an AI chat replay fixture
+
+Replay tests run offline. Recording is a separate, explicitly authorized QA
+activity. Do not provision a model or send project data to a provider merely
+to run the test suite.
+
+## Record
+
+1. Use a synthetic project without private geometry, credentials or business data.
+2. Save the initial `.camproj`. Record the application commit, platform,
+   provider, model/version, preset, tool mode, system prompt and offered schemas.
+3. Capture each user message and every raw model reply for that turn. Preserve
+   call IDs, content, function names and the original argument strings.
+   Do not repair invalid arguments or convert text into calls.
+4. Save `get_job` after each turn. Record any Allow/Deny decision and each
+   Undo/Redo result. Save another project before starting a fresh chat session.
+5. Keep immutable source links and hashes. Review all files for secrets and
+   private data before publishing. Document any redaction without changing a
+   tool's argument shape. Never use an account key as fixture data.
+
+The q08 source used a separate wire capture because the panel had no export.
+This guide does not authorize traffic capture. Use an approved recording
+method in an isolated QA session; never intercept another person's traffic.
+
+## Make the fixture
+
+Use the format and source mapping in
+[`fixtures/README.md`](../../crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/ai_chat/fixtures/README.md).
+Choose complete turns, not only the successful calls. Preserve the original
+reply objects. Keep setup reconstruction separate from recorded output.
+Document why the slice has the same relevant initial state as its source.
+
+Project schemas evolve. Use the normal project loader and explain migrations.
+Update expected values only for a reviewed, intentional change. Do not alter
+raw replies to fit the current parser. Do not preserve an old authorization
+bug by weakening confirmation or refusal expectations.
+
+Project the original job snapshots to stable operation fields. Assert the
+operation count, names, tools, sources and parameters after **each** turn.
+Assert that one Undo reverts the whole mutating turn and one Redo restores it.
+For rejected destructive calls, assert the unchanged document and history.
+Check that refusals appear in the panel and return to the model as errors.
+A model's success text is not evidence that its requested edit succeeded.
+
+## Run and challenge
+
+From the repository root:
+
+```sh
+cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib recorded_q08 -- --nocapture
+cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib egui_app::tests::ai_chat
+cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main
+cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings
+```
+
+Add one named test per fixture in the existing `ai_chat` directory suite.
+The transport must consume only its recorded replies and fail on an extra
+round. Never fall back to the HTTP transport or a live model.
+
+Temporarily perturb the test transport's arguments, run the focused test,
+and verify that its document assertion fails. Restore the perturbation and
+run the same test again. Keep both logs outside the source tree. Do not
+commit the perturbation or change production parsing to make the test pass.
+
+These tests check the application workflow. They are not toolpath goldens,
+proof of collision safety, or approval to run a physical machine.

+## #3411 - Replay recorded local-model conversations
+
+**Decision.** Replay the three complete q08 turns for finishing, editing and
+bulk deletion. Keep the original Ollama replies and raw argument strings.
+Use the real AI panel, inbox, dispatcher and document history. Replace only
+the model transport. Store the source commit and zero-based turn mapping.
+
+**Why.** These are authentic local-model replies from the linked QA run.
+They include invalid enums, wrong entity names, a nested parameter object,
+duplicate operation names, several edits in one turn and two deletes in one
+reply. Hand-written successful replies would not cover those shapes.
+
+**Actual outcomes.** The model does not fulfill the requested zero stock or
+0.2 mm stepdown. Assert the captured final parameters, not the model's prose.
+The edit turn deletes and re-adds only the finishing operation; the roughing
+operation must keep its parameters. Reconstruct that turn's initial finishing
+operation from its preceding job snapshot, separately from recorded output.
+
+**Safety evolution.** The old recording predates the native-delete
+confirmation fix. Test current Allow and Deny paths. Never reproduce the
+historical bypass or change production policy to fit the old result.
+Do not replay the old missing-system-prompt behavior. Do not assert that
+recorded generation or verification results establish machining safety.
+
+**Considered and dropped.** New remote inference and hand-written
+transcripts are not needed. Partial successful round prefixes would omit
+the actual end of a turn. A production parser change is outside this test
+scope. A skill edit is not needed; a docs guide describes recording instead.
+
+**Cost to change later.** Add a fixture and a named test in the same UI
+suite. A new recording must identify its source, initial project and expected
+job values. Preserve old raw replies when document or tool schemas evolve.
